name.value: Green View Motel and RV Park

description.value: Green View Motel & RV Park sits on Highway 3, one kilometre east of Greenwood — reputedly Canada's smallest city — making it a practical overnight stop for cyclists on the Southern Trans-Canada route. The property offers renovated motel rooms with kitchenettes and family units alongside a full-service RV park with pull-through sites (60+ ft), tent camping, water/sewer hookups, and 30-amp electrical service. It is open year-round and accepts multiple payment methods including Interac.

address.value: 256 n Copper Ave, Greenwood, BC, VOH 1JO, Canada
